notablePrerequisites: You control up to four permanents that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
description:
Activate up to four permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Teferi.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Teferi's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, untapping up to four permanents.
Repeat.
If the four permanents can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, you may get infinite mana, and then use Teferi's first loyalty ability instead.
